title: Salman's Long Search for Truth
paragraphs: Before accepting Islam, Salman al-Farisi travelled widely and learned from several religious teachers. He was searching sincerely for the truth.
His journey was difficult, and he faced periods of hardship and slavery. Even then, he did not stop looking for answers.
When Salman met the Prophet ﷺ, he saw signs that a teacher had described to him. This gave him confidence in what he had found.
Salman's story teaches patience in seeking knowledge. It also teaches us not to give up when a sincere search takes time.
